description: ODC: the REFUSAL of the localized image. The locale is born (IESpace.GetOrCreateLocale, `create ILocale` with args.culture) and so is the image (binary in base64), but IImage.CreateLocalizedImage is refused by the platform itself: localized images only exist in the Traditional Web runtime of O11 (the same create passes in tests/jobs/image-localized.json and is refused the same in Reactive and Mobile). Platform limit, not the kernel's.
expectError: Localized Image objects can't be children of Image objects
